Article 280 | Part XII
Chairman + 4 Members
Every 5 Years
Vertical + Horizontal Devolution
Advisory Body
Promotes Fiscal Federalism

items: Match Article 280 with Part XII in match-the-following questions.
Remember the total strength: 1 Chairman + 4 Members.
Note that the Finance Commission is purely an Advisory Body and its recommendations are not binding.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Finance Commission is established under Article 280 in Part XII of the Indian Constitution.
The body consists of a Chairman and 4 other members.
It is constituted every 5 years for recommendations on resource distribution.
It makes recommendations regarding both Vertical and Horizontal Devolution of funds.
It acts as an Advisory Body designed to promote Fiscal Federalism in India.
